definitions.short: properly, a hider , i.e. (abstractly) a hiding, i.e. aversion
definitions.full: H4564. master מַסְתֵּר noun [masculine] hiding, act of hiding ; — construct מִמֶּנּוּ מָּנִים וּכְמַסְתֵּר Isa 53:3 and like a hiding of face from him i.e. like one before whom the face is hidden (e.g. a leper, compare Che Hpt ).
